Seer.directive_rationale: When a Villager questions your results, don't just repeat the fact; demand they explain why they are ignoring hard data.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: After Hoang questioned the need for independent verification of the clear, Nhan responded by asking, 'How does this contradict the Seer’s mechanical role?'
Seer.verdict_notes: Nhan challenged Hoang to explain the logic behind rejecting the Seer's result rather than simply repeating that Cong was clear.

Guard.directive_rationale: Your priority is the Seer. Always shield the Seer until their death is inevitable or they are proven false.
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard protected the Seer during the first night as directed.

Witch.verdict_notes: The Witch did not use the poison potion on any player.
The Witch did not use the poison potion on any player.

Witch.directive_rationale: Your role is to preserve the Seer at all costs.
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nam used the SAVE potion on Nam (self) instead of Nhan.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Seer was alive, but the Witch used the potion to save themselves instead of the Seer.

Villager.directive_rationale: You committed a fatal error by voting for the Seer who just cleared you.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Cong was cleared by Nhan, and Cong voted for Hoang.
Villager.verdict_notes: Cong (acting as the cleared player) voted against another player rather than the Seer.

Villager.directive_rationale: A Seer-cleared player must become the Seer's strongest shield
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Cong confirmed Nhan's claim and later defended Nhan's behavior against Hoang's accusations, calling Hoang's skepticism 'classic wolf tactics'.
Villager.verdict_notes: Cong actively defended the Seer who cleared him.

Villager.directive_rationale: If a Seer provides a clear, rally around it immediately to build a power core.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Hoang and Jin both questioned the validity of the clear and expressed suspicion toward the 'Confirmed Core' narrative.
Villager.verdict_notes: The Villagers (Hoang and Jin) did not endorse the clear; they actively challenged it.
